additional_passkey_intent_phase.name: additional_passkey_intent_phase
additional_passkey_intent_phase.value:
(
    "additional_passkey_intent"."phase" = 'CHALLENGE' and "additional_passkey_intent"."authentication_challenge" is not null
    and "additional_passkey_intent"."authorizing_key_id" is null and "additional_passkey_intent"."authorizing_credential_id" is null
    and "additional_passkey_intent"."authorizing_public_key" is null and "additional_passkey_intent"."registration_verification_identifier" is null
  ) or (
    "additional_passkey_intent"."phase" in ('AUTHORIZED','CONSUMED') and "additional_passkey_intent"."authentication_challenge" is null
    and "additional_passkey_intent"."authorizing_key_id" is not null and "additional_passkey_intent"."authorizing_credential_id" is not null
    and "additional_passkey_intent"."authorizing_public_key" is not null and "additional_passkey_intent"."registration_verification_identifier" is not null
  )

auth_email_command_user_binding.name: auth_email_command_user_binding
auth_email_command_user_binding.value: ("auth_email_command"."user_id" is null and "auth_email_command"."recovery_generation" is null) or ("auth_email_command"."user_id" is not null and "auth_email_command"."recovery_generation" is not null and "auth_email_command"."recovery_generation" >= 0)

email_delivery_material_candidates_idx.name: email_delivery_material_candidates_idx
email_delivery_material_candidates_idx.where: "email_delivery"."ciphertext" IS NOT NULL OR "email_delivery"."verifier_hash" IS NOT NULL

email_delivery_snapshot.name: email_delivery_snapshot
email_delivery_snapshot.value: ("email_delivery"."snapshot_format" is null and "email_delivery"."snapshot_hash" is null and "email_delivery"."replay_window_seconds" is null) or ("email_delivery"."snapshot_format" = 'auth-plunk-v1' and "email_delivery"."snapshot_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and ("email_delivery"."replay_window_seconds" is null or "email_delivery"."replay_window_seconds" between 1 and 600))

email_delivery_envelope.name: email_delivery_envelope
email_delivery_envelope.value: ("email_delivery"."ciphertext" is null and "email_delivery"."nonce" is null and "email_delivery"."tag" is null) or ("email_delivery"."ciphertext" is not null and "email_delivery"."nonce" is not null and "email_delivery"."tag" is not null and "email_delivery"."nonce" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{24}$' and "email_delivery"."tag" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$')

first_google_passkey_intent_authority.name: first_google_passkey_intent_authority
first_google_passkey_intent_authority.value: "first_google_passkey_intent"."phase" not in ('AUTHORIZED','CONSUMED') or "first_google_passkey_intent"."authenticated_at" is not null

first_google_passkey_intent_reason.name: first_google_passkey_intent_reason
first_google_passkey_intent_reason.value: ("first_google_passkey_intent"."phase" = 'INVALIDATED' and "first_google_passkey_intent"."reason" is not null and "first_google_passkey_intent"."reason" in ('unavailable','proof_unavailable','proof_stale','cancelled','superseded')) or ("first_google_passkey_intent"."phase" <> 'INVALIDATED' and "first_google_passkey_intent"."reason" is null)

google_account_intent_target.name: google_account_intent_target
google_account_intent_target.value: ("google_account_intent"."action" = 'LINK' and "google_account_intent"."target_account_id" is null and "google_account_intent"."target_subject" is null) or ("google_account_intent"."action" = 'UNLINK' and "google_account_intent"."target_account_id" is not null and "google_account_intent"."target_subject" is not null)

google_account_intent_proof.name: google_account_intent_proof

google_account_intent_receipt.name: google_account_intent_receipt
google_account_intent_receipt.value: ("google_account_intent"."phase" = 'CONSUMED' and "google_account_intent"."native_account_id" is not null and "google_account_intent"."provider_subject" is not null and "google_account_intent"."outcome" is not null and (("google_account_intent"."action" = 'LINK' and "google_account_intent"."outcome" = 'linked') or ("google_account_intent"."action" = 'UNLINK' and "google_account_intent"."outcome" = 'unlinked'))) or ("google_account_intent"."phase" <> 'CONSUMED' and "google_account_intent"."native_account_id" is null and "google_account_intent"."provider_subject" is null and "google_account_intent"."outcome" is null)

google_account_intent_reason.name: google_account_intent_reason
google_account_intent_reason.value: ("google_account_intent"."phase" = 'INVALIDATED' and "google_account_intent"."reason" is not null and "google_account_intent"."reason" in ('unavailable','expired','cancelled')) or ("google_account_intent"."phase" <> 'INVALIDATED' and "google_account_intent"."reason" is null)

workspace_local_audio_read.name: workspace_local_audio_read
workspace_local_audio_read.using: "workspace"."id"::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) and current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and "workspace"."kind" = 'personal' and "workspace"."lifecycle" = 'active' and "workspace"."auth_organization_id" is null

workspace_display_name.name: workspace_display_name
workspace_display_name.value: length("workspace"."display_name") between 1 and 80 and length(btrim("workspace"."display_name")) > 0 and "workspace"."display_name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' and position(chr(8232) in "workspace"."display_name") = 0 and position(chr(8233) in "workspace"."display_name") = 0

sparra_audio_chunk_samples.name: sparra_audio_chunk_samples
sparra_audio_chunk_samples.value: sample_count between 1 and 8000 and sample_rate = 8000 and channels = 2 and sample_format = 's16le'

sparra_audio_chunk_crypto.name: sparra_audio_chunk_crypto
sparra_audio_chunk_crypto.value: crypto_version = 1 and key_version between 1 and 9007199254740991 and octet_length(nonce) = 12 and octet_length(ciphertext) = sample_count * 4 + 16

sparra_audio_chunk_pin.name: sparra_audio_chunk_pin
sparra_audio_chunk_pin.value: configuration_revision > 0 and isfinite(retention_until) and length(deployment_id) between 1 and 256 and deployment_id !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

sparra_audio_quota_budget.name: sparra_audio_quota_budget
sparra_audio_quota_budget.value: reserved_bytes >= 0 and charged_bytes >= 0 and reserved_bytes + charged_bytes <= 536870912

sparra_call_read.name: sparra_call_read
sparra_call_read.using: "sparra_call"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) and current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and exists (select 1 from public.workspace where workspace.id = "sparra_call"."workspace_id" and workspace.lifecycle = 'active')

sparra_call_update.name: sparra_call_update
sparra_call_update.using: "sparra_call"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) and current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and exists (select 1 from public.workspace where workspace.id = "sparra_call"."workspace_id" and workspace.lifecycle = 'active')
sparra_call_update.withCheck: "sparra_call"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) and current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and exists (select 1 from public.workspace where workspace.id = "sparra_call"."workspace_id" and workspace.lifecycle = 'active')

sparra_call_audio_budget.name: sparra_call_audio_budget
sparra_call_audio_budget.value: audio_reserved_bytes >= 0 and audio_charged_bytes >= 0 and audio_reserved_bytes + audio_charged_bytes <= 20447648

sparra_call_audio_identity.name: sparra_call_audio_identity
sparra_call_audio_identity.value: recording_id is not null or (audio_reserved_bytes = 0 and audio_charged_bytes = 0 and audio_state in ('off','unavailable'))

sparra_call_audio_finish.name: sparra_call_audio_finish
sparra_call_audio_finish.value: (audio_finish_reason is null and audio_total_samples is null and audio_last_sequence is null) or (audio_finish_reason is not null and audio_finish_reason in ('complete','transfer','interrupted','limit','failure') and audio_total_samples is not null and audio_total_samples between 0 and 4800000 and ((audio_total_samples = 0 and audio_last_sequence is null) or (audio_total_samples > 0 and audio_last_sequence is not null and audio_last_sequence between 0 and 599 and audio_total_samples between audio_last_sequence + 1 and (audio_last_sequence + 1) * 8000)))

sparra_call_identity.name: sparra_call_identity
sparra_call_identity.value: length("sparra_call"."deployment_id") between 1 and 256 and length("sparra_call"."provider_call_control_id") between 1 and 1024

sparra_call_retention.name: sparra_call_retention
sparra_call_retention.value: isfinite("sparra_call"."admitted_at") and isfinite("sparra_call"."retention_until") and "sparra_call"."retention_until" = "sparra_call"."admitted_at" + interval '2592000 seconds'

sparra_erasure_read.name: sparra_erasure_read
sparra_erasure_read.using: "sparra_erasure"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) and current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and exists (select 1 from public.workspace where workspace.id = "sparra_erasure"."workspace_id" and workspace.lifecycle = 'active')

sparra_erasure_fence.name: sparra_erasure_fence
sparra_erasure_fence.value: isfinite("sparra_erasure"."requested_at") and isfinite("sparra_erasure"."original_retention_until") and isfinite("sparra_erasure"."fence_until") and "sparra_erasure"."fence_until" = "sparra_erasure"."original_retention_until" + interval '900 seconds'

sparra_erasure_state.name: sparra_erasure_state
sparra_erasure_state.value: ("sparra_erasure"."state" = 'queued' and "sparra_erasure"."completed_at" is null) or ("sparra_erasure"."state" = 'completed' and "sparra_erasure"."completed_at" is not null and isfinite("sparra_erasure"."completed_at"))

sparra_erasure_lease.name: sparra_erasure_lease
sparra_erasure_lease.value: ("sparra_erasure"."lease_token" is null and "sparra_erasure"."lease_until" is null) or ("sparra_erasure"."lease_token" is not null and "sparra_erasure"."lease_until" is not null and isfinite("sparra_erasure"."lease_until"))

sparra_revision_read.name: sparra_revision_read
sparra_revision_read.using: "sparra_knowledge_revision"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) and current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and exists (select 1 from public.workspace where workspace.id = "sparra_knowledge_revision"."workspace_id" and workspace.lifecycle = 'active')

sparra_revision_insert.name: sparra_revision_insert
sparra_revision_insert.withCheck: "sparra_knowledge_revision"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) and current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and exists (select 1 from public.workspace where workspace.id = "sparra_knowledge_revision"."workspace_id" and workspace.lifecycle = 'active')

sparra_revision_business_name.name: sparra_revision_business_name
sparra_revision_business_name.value: length("sparra_knowledge_revision"."business_name") + length(regexp_replace("sparra_knowledge_revision"."business_name", U&'[\0001-\FFFF]', '', 'g')) between 1 and 80 and "sparra_knowledge_revision"."business_name" = btrim("sparra_knowledge_revision"."business_name") and "sparra_knowledge_revision"."business_name" !~ U&'[\0001-\001F\007F-\009F\2028\2029]'

sparra_revision_local_recording.name: sparra_revision_local_recording
sparra_revision_local_recording.value: "sparra_knowledge_revision"."recording_policy" <> 'local_30d' or ("sparra_knowledge_revision"."recording_contact_phone" is not null and not "sparra_knowledge_revision"."recording_enabled")

voice_binding_read.name: voice_binding_read
voice_binding_read.using: "voice_private"."deployment_binding"."service_login" = session_user and "voice_private"."deployment_binding"."service_role_oid" = (select oid from pg_catalog.pg_roles where rolname = session_user)

voice_binding_local_audio_read.name: voice_binding_local_audio_read
voice_binding_local_audio_read.using: "voice_private"."deployment_binding"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) and current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and "voice_private"."deployment_binding"."admission_enabled" and "voice_private"."deployment_binding"."contract_version" = 2 and "voice_private"."deployment_binding"."local_audio_enabled"

voice_recording_id.name: voice_recording_id
voice_recording_id.value: length("voice_private"."recording_purge"."provider_recording_id") between 1 and 256 and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."provider_recording_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]+$' and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."provider_recording_id" not in ('.','..')

voice_recording_archive_receipt.name: voice_recording_archive_receipt
voice_recording_archive_receipt.value: ("voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_ciphertext_sha256" is null and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_encrypted_bytes" is null and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_key_version" is null) or ("voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_ciphertext_sha256" is not null and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_ciphertext_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_encrypted_bytes" is not null and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_encrypted_bytes" between 17 and 33554448 and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_key_version" is not null and "voice_private"."recording_purge"."archive_key_version" between 1 and 9007199254740991)
